What a following is worth, to her.

Her audience stays hers. True Convo reads her accounts with her sign-ins and writes nothing without a yes. It never holds her audience.
Her words, her voice. Scripts and captions come from how she already writes. Corrections teach it. Nothing is invented about her.
Her money, her account. Sales go through an account she already has. Cloudwork takes nothing and sees nothing.
Her numbers, her Mac. Three years of posts and their numbers live on her machine, as a map she can walk.
Open core. Copy it, change it, label it as your own. The True Convo name is the only thing kept back.
Leave any time. Export everything in a form that works without us.

Not on your own

More than software.

True Convo is meant to come with people: lessons in plain words, others in the same spot as Priya, and the apps and templates they make and share.

ComingLearn

How other creators priced a first workshop, with their real numbers and what they'd change.

ComingPeople

Creators with a following and no income yet, comparing what actually paid and what didn't.

ComingShared

A brand-reply template and a media-kit layout, shared by the people who made them.

None of this exists yet. It's what we hope to build with the first people who use True Convo, and we'll say so plainly until it's real.

11:00 PM

The posts went out. The audience stayed hers.

Two videos, a care sheet, one brand reply and a workshop page, all from a Mac that sent one contract to the cloud because Priya said yes. No account with us. No ads. Nothing sold on.

Where this stands. True Convo is in development and not out yet. Built so far: the pill, dictation at the cursor, the Desk with a model on the Mac, encrypted storage, and the first engines for lists, habits, tasks, the agenda, mail, the calendar, time and sources. Being built now: the PA, the iPhone, sync and the first-run guide. Reading her accounts, the voice module, the site builder and building her own apps come after launch. The lessons, the community and the shared library are a plan too; none of them exist yet. Priya and everything on this page are invented to show the plan; the tests decide the order.
